pin.title: Mabane section, Sweetwaters, outside Pietermaritzburg (map point approximate): eight men shot dead inside a vehicle, night of 15 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. Mabane section, Sweetwaters, outside Pietermaritzburg. Mabane is not in Nominatim, and Nominatim has no place point for Sweetwaters; it matches "Sweetwaters" to Mbubu Road on the western side of Pietermaritzburg, and the pin is a point on that road (-29.6003, 30.3061). Area level, about 5 km.
